metadata.provenance: All values are synthetic; no external operational data was used.

config.noise_note: Synthetic independent Gaussian sensor noise; assumptions only, not measured plant noise.

network_validation_summary.flow_balance_tolerance_method: Two-sided 99% Gaussian envelope from propagated independent inlet/outlet flow-sensor noise summed across the facility; not an empirically calibrated 3-sigma residual limit.
